en-US.author: Objective Corporation Limited
en-US.description: Software purpose-built for planning and building teams. All the tools you need to assess, compare, annotate and approve digital plans.
en-US.name: Objective Trapeze
en-US.releaseNotes:
New
- Added callout to the tools available in Side by Side in Document Compare
Fixes
- Fixed a crash when opening large TIFF pages (> 2GB)
- Fixed a crash when opening large BMPs, JPEGs and PNGs (> 2GB)
- Fixed a crash when help is used with the help panel disabled
- Fixed an error saving PDFs in the 32-bit version
- Fixed save page incorrectly enabled when a page error has occurred
